title: 0.2.1 Shop layout
h1: Item 14: how should all seven shop rows fit without scrolling?
brief: Spec item 14 asks for all seven rows at 720 × 1280, no scroll container, and the panel still clear of the HUD. Seven rows do not fit beside Spin, Harvest and Dev, so both options are built behind config shop_layout (Dev panel). Rows are 64 px with 24 pt text (shop_row_height, shop_font_size; were 120 px / 28 pt). The build defaults to B, the only one that passes the HUD tests. Nothing is final until you pick.

options.title: Compact: always-on panel
on: all seven rows and Journal on the farm view
cut: covers the centrifuge, crate and truck
covers Spin at the second stop, so the HUD tests fail

options.title: Sheet: Shop button opens it
on: farm clear until Shop is tapped (bottom right)
all seven rows, Journal and Close when open; the farm is dimmed
Dev hidden while it is open
cut: open question: should Shop hide during the zoom?

ref.title: 0.2.0 (play-tested): scrolling panel
ref.text: The build you play-tested, with the scroll panel item 14 removes.

ask: vote A or B, and say whether the 64 px / 24 pt rows stay. 0.3.0's Shop sheet replaces this panel later (spec: a stopgap).
